Details & help

Corresponding arms share branch and polygon definitions. Detail controls smaller features; symmetry adjusts their shape. Crystal geometry adds an image-fitted central hexagon; faint cores are inferred.

Close gaps bridges narrow openings. The hanger adds an external rimmed loop above the flake, joined by a short neck. Neck length measures from the tip to the hole edge. Hole filling and gap closing preserve its opening.

The four top buttons independently show layers; at least one stays visible. Crystal geo shows polygon guides. Use crystal geometry for cut chooses the exported shape. The SVG contains only closed cut boundaries, in millimeters.

References 11–20: Wilson A. Bentley, Smithsonian Institution Archives. Photo credits.
